blocks.content: The Central Vigilance Commission (CVC) is the apex anti-corruption watchdog of the Government of India. It supervises vigilance administration and works to prevent corruption in central government institutions.
The Central Vigilance Commission (CVC) is the apex anti-corruption watchdog of the Government of India.

items: CVC is designated as the apex body specifically for anti-corruption and vigilance administration in India.
Its mandate is focused on central government institutions rather than state-level administration.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The Central Vigilance Commission (CVC) serves as the apex anti-corruption watchdog for the Government of India.
It exercises supervisory control over vigilance administration across central government bodies.
The primary objective of the CVC is to prevent corrupt practices within central government institutions.
